### What is broken

Opening `/widgets/` shows page not found (404) instead of the widgets page (200).

### Why it is broken

The part that matches web addresses to pages compares them exactly as typed, without first making them uniform, so the final slash in `/widgets/` prevents a match. A local test confirmed this cause.

### How to fix it

Make each address uniform before comparing it, such as by removing a final slash, so `/widgets/` reaches the same page as `/widgets`. The change is small and limited to that one comparison. Choose hotfix because the fix is small and every safety check passes.
